name: id
description: OpenFEMA claim record id.

name: state
description: 2-letter state of the insured property.

name: reportedCity
description: City as reported. Usually redacted ('Currently Unavailable').

name: reportedZipCode
description: 5-digit ZIP code.

name: countyCode
description: 5-digit county FIPS code.

name: censusGeoid
description: Census block group GEOID.

name: nfipCommunityName
description: NFIP community name.

name: latitude
description: Approximate latitude (rounded by FEMA).

name: longitude
description: Approximate longitude (rounded by FEMA).

name: dateOfLoss
description: Date of loss, ISO-8601 text. Parsed to DATE in SQL.

name: yearOfLoss
description: Year of loss.

name: openDate
description: Date the claim was opened (reported), ISO-8601 text.

name: causeOfDamage
description: Cause-of-damage code (see data_pipeline/nfip_codes.py).

name: floodEvent
description: Named flood event, e.g. '2026-06-Arthur-TS' (often NULL).

name: waterDepth
description: Depth of flood water in the building, inches.

name: floodWaterDuration
description: Hours the water remained in the building.

name: buildingDamageAmount
description: Adjuster-estimated building damage, USD.

name: contentsDamageAmount
description: Adjuster-estimated contents damage, USD.

name: amountPaidOnBuildingClaim
description: Amount paid for building damage, USD.

name: amountPaidOnContentsClaim
description: Amount paid for contents damage, USD.

name: amountPaidOnIncreasedCostOfComplianceClaim
description: Amount paid under ICC coverage, USD.

name: netBuildingPaymentAmount
description: Net building payment after recoveries, USD.

name: netContentsPaymentAmount
description: Net contents payment after recoveries, USD.

name: nonPaymentReasonBuilding
description: Why the building portion was not paid (code).

name: nonPaymentReasonContents
description: Why the contents portion was not paid (code).

name: ratedFloodZone
description: Flood zone used to rate the policy.

name: occupancyType
description: Occupancy code.

name: primaryResidenceIndicator
description: True if primary residence.

name: totalBuildingInsuranceCoverage
description: Building coverage limit at time of loss, USD.

name: totalContentsInsuranceCoverage
description: Contents coverage limit at time of loss, USD.

name: buildingDeductibleCode
description: Coded building deductible.

name: contentsDeductibleCode
description: Coded contents deductible.

name: policyCount
description: Number of policies represented by the row.

name: asOfDate
description: Date FEMA last refreshed this record (ISO-8601 text).
